outlinePolicy: Full support rectangle, including all detached and weak-alpha pixels. Texture alpha retains transparent gaps; no polygon simplification clips the artwork.
packingPolicy: Integer translations only. Smallest area found by deterministic height-sorted shelf search across candidate widths, not a claim of globally optimal bin packing. Two transparent pixels surround each frame; both dimensions <=4096.
generatedLayoutPolicy: Automatic dividing corridors lie within 20% of nominal cell pitch. Optional explicit layouts are bound to the exact PNG hash, dimensions and ordered frame names. Every dividing corridor must be free of alpha>8 across the whole image, with two clear pixels on each side. Actual cuts and the sidecar hash are recorded. Alpha>8 figures keep their cell identity. Every alpha1..8 pixel belongs to the nearest alpha>8 figure pixel by exact squared Euclidean distance, with equal-distance owners resolved to the lower original frame index. No nontransparent RGBA pixel is dropped or changed.
anchorPolicy: Draft only: PPU uses median native strong-body height ratio for pose-0 frames (all frames if absent), or an explicit override. X preserves the old pivot offset from the largest strong component's pixel-median body center. Y preserves the old pivot offset from the strong body's lower edge. Weapons, crouching and floating poses require human/continuous review; these are not semantic foot detections.
productionPolicy: Update the matching approved production job only after visual/continuous review, then call ApplyApprovedRevision with currentSourceSha256. Never rerun initial inventory/application.
